    Depth of a nonzero morphism #

    The depth d(f) of a nonzero morphism f of a ray category is the maximal length of a path of irreducible morphisms with value f (BGRS 8.4). In a ray category with finitely many nonzero morphisms below each one, path lengths are bounded by the number of nonzero morphisms below the value (RayCat.length_le_ncard_below), so the depth exists, and it strictly increases along nonzero composites with non-invertible morphisms.
